title: Army reschedules detonation of toxic explosives in Iowa for Wednesday
script: Here is what viewers need to know right now. Reports are focusing on this development: Army reschedules detonation of toxic explosives in Iowa for Wednesday. In simple words, The U.S. Army has rescheduled the detonation of about five tons of bomb-making material in Iowa to Wednesday to accommodate weather and "mitigation measures."
